subject: Coordination: MAP runway — staging org + credentials + peering timeline
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@pulsehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: ops@vandercloud.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + POC environment checklist

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at PulseHealth is excited to move forward with a short POC to validate Redwood’s latency and privacy controls for our patient-facing summarization flow. We discussed a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to outline environment setup and a target close window.

High-level asks from our infra/security team:
- A staging org for PulseHealth with RBAC scoping (service account for the POC)
- Short-lived API keys and recommended rotation cadence
- IP allowlist for our staging CIDR and VPC peering for private traffic to minimize egress exposure
- A simple checklist so our security/compliance reviewer can sign off quickly (SOC2 evidence pointers would help)

Can you propose a concrete timeline and concrete artifacts we’ll need to produce on our side? Our target is a two-week POC starting Aug 24 and a decision meeting on Sep 7.

Appreciate it — copying our infrastructure lead Chris (ops@vandercloud.com).

Best,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Product, PulseHealth
[attachment: MAP_request_v1.docx]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, ops@vandercloud.com
Date: 2026-08-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC environment checklist

Emily — great to hear, and appreciate the clear target dates. Below is a proposed MAP runway tailored to the items you listed. I’ll also attach a short artifact checklist for your security reviewer.

Proposed MAP milestones (compact two-week POC):
1) Aug 13–14: Agreement on scope + exchange of contact points + HubSpot MAP doc signed (we’ll share the DocuSign link)
2) Aug 15–18: Redwood provisions a PulseHealth staging org and creates a scoped service account + issues time-limited API keys (90-day rotation recommended)
3) Aug 19–21: IP allowlist + VPC peering request from PulseHealth -> we validate and schedule peering window (typical 2–4 hour maintenance window)
4) Aug 24–Sep 4: POC execution (latency/throughput tests, privacy controls verification, basic eval prompts)
5) Sep 7: Decision meeting — outcomes: move-to-prod, extend POC, or close

Quick asks for PulseHealth from our side:
- Target staging CIDR and preferred peering subnet (for planning)
- Point-of-contact for peering ticket and ASN if you have one
- Security checklist reviewer email for the SOC2/retention evidence (we’ll surface the right docs)

I’m attaching a short MAP checklist PDF and a link to the HubSpot MAP record for your signing. Marissa — can you add our recommended credential templates and the service-account YAML to the attachments? Jonas — please confirm a peering blackout window we can offer next week.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_PulseHealth_v1.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Emily Park <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC environment checklist

Adding the checklist items PulseHealth needs to provide and what Redwood will deliver. I’m keeping this intentionally prescriptive so your security team can check boxes quickly.

What PulseHealth should provide (by Aug 18):
- Staging org name and owner email
- Staging CIDR(s) for IP allowlist (e.g., 10.5.32.0/24)
- VPC peering contact + peering subnet range
- List of evaluation scopes (sample prompt sets, max seq length, expected concurrency)

What Redwood will deliver (by Aug 18):
- Scoped service account + service-account-template.yaml (attachment)
- Time-limited API key (issued, with rotation guidance) and instructions for key revocation
- Short SOC2 evidence bundle: data retention policy excerpt, audit-log export instructions, and isolation note for dedicated/private options
- VPC peering request form filled and initial validation; we’ll propose a maintenance window when ready

Attachment references:
- service-account-template.yaml (example service-account for PulseHealth POC)
- vpc_peering_request.json (pre-filled form for your network team)

Emily — if you can confirm the staging CIDR and a peering contact (name + email) by Aug 18 EOD we’ll lock the provisioning timeline.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: service-account-template.yaml]
[attachment: vpc_peering_request.json]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Emily Park <emily@pulsehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC environment checklist

Quick network note from ops side. We can support VPC peering during the following windows next week (all windows in PDT):
- Tue Aug 19 — 02:00–06:00
- Wed Aug 20 — 22:00–01:00
- Thu Aug 21 — 01:00–05:00

The typical steps we need from PulseHealth NIC: peering request form (vpc_peering_request.json), ACLs for the peering subnet, and the ASN or account id. We’ll coordinate the peering setup and monitoring during the window and validate packet flow.

Note on IP allowlist for API keys: we support both CIDR-level allowlist and per-key IP restrictions. For the quickest path, provide a single staging CIDR. If you need tighter controls we can provision per-key restrictions but that adds one day to the timeline.

If the Aug 24 POC start is firm, I recommend targeting the Tue Aug 19 02:00–06:00 window for peering so we have a buffer before the POC start. Let me know which window you prefer and we’ll book it.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Infrastructure Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Park <emily@pulsehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-19T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC environment checklist

Thanks all — this looks good and actionable. Confirming the following from PulseHealth:
- Staging CIDR: 10.5.32.0/24
- Peering contact: Chris Morales <ops@vandercloud.com> (we’ve copied him earlier)
- We’ll sign the HubSpot MAP doc today and upload the network team’s peering ticket via the vpc_peering_request.json attachment.

We prefer the Tue Aug 19 02:00–06:00 window you recommended. Please proceed with provisioning the staging org and the time-limited API key; we’ll hand the peering ticket to Chris to complete the ASN/account details.

A couple of small asks before we begin: can you include a short note on how Redwood recommends rotating the demo API keys mid-POC if we want automatic rotation? Also — any simple test endpoints you recommend we run once peering is up?

Looking forward — Emily
Emily Park
Head of Product, PulseHealth
